result.instructions: Tools for Copper, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Copper data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run copper_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run copper_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run copper_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. copper_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: copper_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: Get details of the authenticated Copper account. Copper REST: GET /account.

tools.name: copper_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users in the Copper account (id, name, email) — useful for resolving assignee ids. Copper REST: POST /users/search.

tools.name: copper_search_people
tools.title: Search people
tools.description: Search/list people (contacts). All filters optional; returns a page of people. Copper REST: POST /people/search.

emails.description: Filter to people with any of these email addresses.

assignee_ids.description: Filter to people owned by these user ids.

company_ids.description: Filter to people at these company ids.

tags.description: Filter to people carrying any of these tags.

tools.name: copper_get_person
tools.title: Get person
tools.description: Get a single person (contact) by id. Copper REST: GET /people/{id}.

tools.name: copper_search_companies
tools.title: Search companies
tools.description: Search/list companies. All filters optional; returns a page of companies. Copper REST: POST /companies/search.

assignee_ids.description: Filter to companies owned by these user ids.

tags.description: Filter to companies carrying any of these tags.

tools.name: copper_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Copper REST: GET /companies/{id}.

tools.name: copper_search_opportunities
tools.title: Search opportunities

assignee_ids.description: Filter to opportunities owned by these user ids.

pipeline_ids.description: Filter to opportunities in these pipelines.

pipeline_stage_ids.description: Filter to opportunities at these pipeline stages.

company_ids.description: Filter to opportunities at these company ids.

tags.description: Filter to opportunities carrying any of these tags.

tools.name: copper_get_opportunity

assignee_ids.description: Filter to leads owned by these user ids.

tags.description: Filter to leads carrying any of these tags.

tools.name: copper_get_lead
tools.title: Get lead

tools.title: Search tasks

tools.name: copper_list_activities
tools.title: List activities
tools.description: List activities (notes, calls, meetings, system events) attached to a record. Copper REST: POST /activities/search.

parent_type.description: Restrict to activities on a single record of this type (requires parent_id).

parent_id.description: The id of the parent record to list activities for (requires parent_type).

minimum_activity_date.description: Earliest activity date, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

maximum_activity_date.description: Latest activity date, as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: copper_list_activity_types
tools.title: List activity types
tools.description: List the account's activity types (user + system), needed to log an activity. Copper REST: GET /activity_types.

tools.name: copper_list_pipelines
tools.title: List pipelines
tools.description: List sales pipelines and their stages (ids needed to place opportunities). Copper REST: GET /pipelines.

tools.name: copper_create_person
tools.title: Create person
tools.description: Create a new person (contact). Copper REST: POST /people.

company_id.description: Id of the company this person works at.

company_name.description: Company name (if not linking by company_id).

assignee_id.description: User id to own this person.

tools.name: copper_update_person
tools.title: Update person
tools.description: Update fields on an existing person. Only provided fields are changed. Copper REST: PUT /people/{id}.

company_id.description: Id of the company this person works at.

assignee_id.description: User id to own this person.

tools.name: copper_create_company
tools.title: Create company
tools.description: Create a new company. Copper REST: POST /companies.

email_domain.description: The company's email domain, e.g. example.com.

assignee_id.description: User id to own this company.

tools.name: copper_create_opportunity
tools.title: Create opportunity
tools.description: Create a new opportunity (deal). `name` and `primary_contact_id` are required by Copper. Copper REST: POST /opportunities.

primary_contact_id.description: Id of the primary contact (person) for this opportunity (required by Copper).

pipeline_id.description: Id of the pipeline to place the opportunity in.

assignee_id.description: User id to own this opportunity.

tools.name: copper_create_lead
tools.title: Create lead
tools.description: Create a new lead. Copper REST: POST /leads.

company_name.description: Company name the lead is associated with.

assignee_id.description: User id to own this lead.

tools.name: copper_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: Create a new task. Copper REST: POST /tasks.

related_resource_type.description: Type of record to attach the task to (requires related_resource_id).

related_resource_id.description: Id of the record to attach the task to (requires related_resource_type).

assignee_id.description: User id to own this task.

due_date.description: Due date as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

reminder_date.description: Reminder date as a Unix timestamp (seconds).

tools.name: copper_log_activity
tools.title: Log activity
tools.description: Log a user activity (e.g. a note or call) on a record. Get the activity_type_id from copper_list_activity_types. Copper REST: POST /activities.

parent_type.description: The kind of record to attach the activity to.

parent_id.description: The id of the record to attach the activity to.

activity_type_id.description: Id of a 'user' activity type (from copper_list_activity_types).

activity_date.description: When the activity occurred, as a Unix timestamp (seconds). Defaults to now.
